_comment: The only lines in this product that describe races that already
happened. Every one of them is a claim about the real world that the
user can check against his own memory, so they are gated hard in
overlay_booth._career_call(): no recorded result, no line.
The wording distinction that matters: `career_won_here` and friends fire
only when the record is in the SAME CAR CLASS. Winning at Montreal in a
1992 Williams is not a thing you can say about a man in a 2025 McLaren,
so a cross-class record uses `career_been_here`, which is deliberately
vague about what he was driving.
Slots: {n} visits, {pos} best finish here, {last} last finish here,
{wins} wins here, {event} rF2's own event name, {trk} circuit.

career_won_here.t: {drv} has won here before, and he will fancy his chances again.
This is happy ground for {drv} — a winner at {trk} already.
{drv} knows how to win at {trk}. He's done it before.
A circuit that owes {drv} nothing — he's already got a win here.
{drv} arrives at a place he's beaten everybody at once before.
Previous winner here, {drv}. That counts for something on a day like this.

career_podium_here.t: {drv} has been on the podium at {trk} before — {pos} his best in {n} visits.
A podium here already for {drv}. He goes well at this circuit.
{drv} has stood on the podium at {trk}. He'll want the top step this time.
Best finish of {pos} here for {drv}, and he has looked comfortable at {trk} every time.
This circuit suits {drv} — a podium on the board here already.

career_back.t: {drv} back at {trk}, where he finished {last} last time out.
Visit number {n} to {trk} for {drv}. Best of {pos} so far.
{drv} was {last} here last time. He'll want better than that.
{n} visits to {trk} now for {drv}, and {pos} is still the benchmark to beat.
Last time we were here {drv} came home {last}.
{drv} returns to {trk} — {pos} his best result at this circuit.

career_dnf_here.t: {drv} didn't see the flag here last time. He'll want to put that right.
Unfinished business at {trk} for {drv} — a retirement on his last visit.
The last time {drv} raced here it ended early. That one still stings.
{drv} has a DNF against his name at {trk}. Today is the correction.

career_been_here.t: {drv} has raced at {trk} before, though not in machinery like this.
Familiar ground for {drv}, if a very different car.
{drv} knows {trk}. Whether that helps in one of these is another question.
Not a new circuit for {drv} — but this is a new way of going round it.

career_first_visit.t: A new circuit for {drv} — his first race at {trk}.
{drv} has never raced here before. Everything he learns today is new.
First visit to {trk} for {drv}, and no history to lean on.
{trk} is unknown ground for {drv}. That is either a problem or an opportunity.

career_form.t: That's {n} races without a finish for {drv}. He needs one today.
{drv} arrives on the back of a podium. The form is there.
Three races, three finishes for {drv}. Quietly building something.
{drv} has been in the points every time out recently.
The recent run has not been kind to {drv}, and he knows it.
